title: Why a High‑Yield Savings Account Beats a Regular One

scenes.text: Can a 4.5% APY savings account outpace a 0.5% traditional account?

scenes.label: COMPOUNDING POWER
scenes.text: At 4.5%, $10,000 grows to $12,340 in 5 years; at 0.5% it reaches only $10,255.

scenes.label: FDIC INSURANCE
scenes.text: Both accounts are FDIC‑insured up to $250,000, so safety isn’t sacrificed.

scenes.label: ACCESS & FEES
scenes.text: Most high‑yield accounts have no monthly fees and free online transfers.
